steps.content: Welcome to Sambora Kinigi Lodge! 🦍 I'm here to help you plan your unforgettable gorilla trekking adventure in Rwanda.
Are you interested in learning about gorilla trekking, our luxury accommodations, or would you like to make a booking?
Gorilla trekking in Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park is truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience! You'll spend up to an hour with endangered mountain gorillas in their natural habitat.

Here's what you should know:

• Permits cost $1,500 per person
• Minimum age is 15 years
• We recommend booking 6 months in advance
• Sambora Kinigi is perfectly located near the park entrance
Would you like to know more about:
We offer luxury boutique accommodations designed for your ultimate comfort after an exhilarating day of trekking!

✨ Our all-inclusive rooms include:

• Private balconies with stunning garden views
• Complimentary 45-minute massage
• All meals featuring fresh, local cuisine
• House wines and stocked minibar
• Evening fires and warm bottles for your bed
• Professional boot cleaning after muddy treks
The rate is approximately $700 per person per night, covering everything you need for a worry-free stay.
Would you like to:
I'm happy to break down the costs for you:

steps.title: 💎 Sambora Kinigi All-Inclusive Stay
steps.description:
$700 per person/night

Includes: all meals, drinks, wines, minibar, 45-min massage, WiFi, cultural performances

steps.title: 🦍 Gorilla Permit
steps.description:
$1,500 per person (book separately, 6 months ahead)

30% discount Nov-May with 2+ nights at other parks

steps.content:
Example 3-Day Package:
• 2 nights accommodation: $1,400/person
• 1 gorilla trek permit: $1,500/person
• Total: ~$2,900/person (all-inclusive luxury!)
Many guests say this once-in-a-lifetime experience is priceless. The personalized service, gourmet meals, and unforgettable gorilla encounter make it worth every penny.
What would you like to do next?

Great question! Gorilla permits are essential for your trek. Here's everything you need to know:

steps.title: 💰 Pricing
steps.description:
• $1,500 for international visitors
• $500 for foreign residents of Rwanda
• 💡 30% off if visiting Nov-May AND staying 2+ nights at other Rwanda parks

steps.title: 📅 Booking
steps.description:
• Book at least 6 months in advance
• Only 96 permits available per day
• We can help arrange permits for you

steps.title: ✅ What's Included
steps.description:
• Park entrance
• Guided trek
• 1 hour with gorillas

steps.title: ❌ Not Included
steps.description:
• Porter fees (recommended - ~$15)
• Guide tips
• Accommodation (covered in our all-inclusive rate!)

steps.content: Would you like me to connect you with our team to secure permits for your dates?
Excellent question! Proper preparation ensures a comfortable and memorable trek.

steps.title: 👕 Clothing
steps.description:
✅ Hiking boots (we'll clean them!)
✅ Layered, moisture-wicking clothes
✅ Rain jacket
✅ Hand gloves
✅ Long pants and long sleeves

steps.title: 📸 Equipment
steps.description:
✅ Good camera (no flash allowed)
✅ Binoculars
✅ Insect repellent
✅ Sunscreen

steps.content: 🌤️ Weather tip: Mornings are cool, hiking can be hot. Expect mist and rain. Layered clothing is your best friend!

⏰ Trek Day Timeline:
• 7:00 AM: Arrive at RDB offices in Kinigi for briefing
• We'll arrange early breakfast and transportation
• Porters available (~$15) to carry your daypack
Do you have confirmed dates for your trek?
Rwanda is a year-round gorilla trekking destination, but there are some considerations:

steps.title: ☀️ Dry Seasons (Peak)
steps.description:
June - September & December - February

✅ Easier hiking conditions
✅ Less mud
❌ Higher demand for permits

steps.title: 🌧️ Wet Seasons (Green)
steps.description:
March - May & October - November

✅ 30% permit discount available
✅ Lush scenery
✅ Fewer tourists
❌ Muddy trails (but we clean your boots!)

steps.content: 💡 Pro Tip: We recommend November-May for the discount AND beautiful landscapes. Our all-inclusive package means you'll be comfortable regardless of weather!
⚠️ Important: Regardless of when you visit, book permits 6 months ahead!
